$comment: Every change the edition makes to its base witness (text), and every difference of the other witness, classified (collation). Classes: orthographic (spelling only), variant (another reading), witness-error, recension, review (not yet decided). check.py fails on an unlisted difference and on a stale entry.

text.why: W1 breaks the word at a pañcāśat marker (यत् [45] चिद्धि); the Saṃhitā joins t + c as cc (यच्चिद्धि), as W2 (यत् ॥ चिद् धि, split at its line) and RV 1.25.1 (यच् चिद् धि) show.

collation.note: W1 doubles the ṇ after v (द॒धि॒क्राव्ण्णो), the Taittirīya spelling; W2 writes it once.
W1 writes श्ञ for श्न (अश्ञोति), the Taittirīya spelling of the ś–n cluster.
W2 prints हि॒र्ण्यये॑न, dropping the a of hiraṇyayena; W1 and RV 1.35.2 have हिरण्ययेन.
The gaṇeśvara text writes ख्ष for क्ष (तच्चख्षुः), the Taittirīya pronunciation spelling.
The gaṇeśvara text (OCR) reads श॒क्रम्; W1 and RV 7.66.16 have शुक्रम्.
The gaṇeśvara text (OCR) reads मादाम; W1 has मोदाम (the series jīvema, nandāma, modāma).
The gaṇeśvara text (OCR) drops the visarga of śaradaḥ before śatam (श॒रद॑श॒त).
The gaṇeśvara text (OCR) reads अर्जीताः; W1 has अजीताः, ‘unconquered’.
The gaṇeśvara text (OCR) reads सूर्यन्त॒शे; W1 and RV 7.66.16 have सूर्यं दृशे.
The gaṇeśvara text (OCR) reads अर्णवा वि॒भ्राज॑मानः, losing the -d of arṇavād.
The gaṇeśvara text writes मद्ध्यात् (dh doubled), the Taittirīya spelling.
The gaṇeśvara text writes -थ्स for -त्स before s (मध्याथ्स), the Taittirīya spelling.
The gaṇeśvara text (OCR) garbles लोहिताक्षः as हि॑िता॒ख्षः.
The gaṇeśvara text (OCR) has a doubled vowel sign in हि॑िता॒ख्षः.
The gaṇeśvara text writes ख्ष for क्ष (लोहिताख्षः).
W1 writes the r of sūryaḥ as ऱ् (सूऱ्यो), a Taittirīya spelling; the gaṇeśvara text has र्.
W1 writes बो॒द्ध्युरु (dh doubled before y), the Taittirīya spelling; W2 बो॒ध्युरु.
W2 reads मि॒मी॒मसि; W1 and RV 1.25.1 have मिनीमसि, ‘we transgress’ (√mī).

The other half of M’s transposition अङ्गाकरं for अङ्गारकं.
